notes: Checked on 2026-10-09 using unauthenticated Python urllib requests with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1. Read the entire 96756-character markdown conversion, including all appendices and references, and checked relevant passages against the 38-page PDF using PyMuPDF. The saved manuscript is arXiv:2211.14228v6, revised 30 May 2023 and dated May 31, 2023. It contains no explicit data/code availability or on-request statement, preregistration, external repository URL, or external supplementary-file link. Markdown URL scan and PDF URI-link extraction both returned no links. Statements above quote the relevant in-paper materials references and data-handling descriptions; they are not promises of public access. Figure 3 and Appendices A-D provide prompts, examples, acceptance criteria, and scoring rubrics; Appendix E provides additional aggregate analyses, not participant records. Acknowledgements, conflict-of-interest text, and footnotes contain no release information. The screening form's data_and_code has empty data_url and code_url; final.open_items is absent (there is no final field). S2 is the relevant child intervention; the form leaves its pseudo-randomized allocation method unresolved. The unrelated OSF project found through author searching is documented under searches and excluded from deposits. The article itself and unrelated search hits are not counted as c173 data deposits.
